name: Vranaropana Tailam (Oil)

sections.introduction: Vranaropana Tailam (Oil) is an Ayurvedic oil which is useful in healing wounds. Vrana refers to a wound and ropana means healing.
sections.ingredients:
Madhuchishta (Bees wax) 
 Sesame oil / Coconut oil 
 Latex of Snuhi 
 Latex of Arka plant 

 Method of Preparation 
 This herbal oil is made by Taila paka vidhi (method). 
 Method of Usage 
 It is used externally. 
 Dip a clean piece of cloth in this oil and spread it on the wound or insert a wick dipped in oil in deep or tubular wounds.
sections.indications:
Promotes faster wound healing 
 Prevents infection 
 Prevents pus formation
sections.contraindications:
There are no reported side effects with this formulation on applying externally. 
 This oil should not be consumed orally. 


 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

Vranaropana Tailam (Oil) 
 Introduction 
 Vranaropana Tailam (Oil) is an Ayurvedic oil which is useful in healing wounds. Vrana refers to a wound and ropana means healing. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Madhuchishta (Bees wax) 
 Sesame oil / Coconut oil 
 Latex of Snuhi 
 Latex of Arka plant 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 This herbal oil is made by Taila paka vidhi (method). 
 Method of Usage 
 It is used externally. 
 Dip a clean piece of cloth in this oil and spread it on the wound or insert a wick dipped in oil in deep or tubular wounds. 
 Indications 
 
 Promotes faster wound healing 
 Prevents infection 
 Prevents pus formation 
 
 Contraindications 
 
 There are no reported side effects with this formulation on applying externally. 
 This oil should not be consumed orally. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
